fb_text:
A client swears your guy never showed.

The visit got done Tuesday. By Friday the client "doesn't remember anyone coming." Now you're digging through texts trying to prove your own work.

FieldNotes ends that argument.

Your crew voice-notes each stop like they already text you. Every visit becomes a timestamped log. And the client gets a clean, professional recap email — rewritten so it reads like it came from your office, not the truck. You approve it before anything sends.

So when "were you even here?" shows up, your reply isn't an argument. It's a timestamped recap.

I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. I built recaps into FieldNotes because I lived this exact dispute.

30 days free. No credit card.
